answer: Convex namespace rent curve. Each agent identity must rent a distinct storage namespace; monthly rent starts at $0.05 and rises 20% per additional namespace funded from the same payment source. The charge repeats, so an attacker creating N identities pays the sum of that rising schedule, not one fee. Velvet metadata is priced at cost, not scored. Ivory badges do not waive rent. Timber logs track namespace arrears; unpaid rent disables writes.
